description: Role Title: Bluebook Citation Specialist (Law Students & Recent JDs) Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote Opportunity Snapshot Pay: $50–80/hour You’ll need: Current or recent law school enrollment, hands-on Bluebook experience, and law journal or law review editing experience Your tasks: Review citation-checking rubrics and build sample cite-checking tasks Job Description micro1 is engaging law students and recent law graduates with law journal experience to support a legal citation project. Apply Bluebook rules consistently across all submissions. Flag ambiguous cases to project coordinators instead of resolving them silently. Strong working knowledge of The Bluebook, including pincites, short forms, signals, and parentheticals. Able to explain why a citation is wrong, not just that it is — the reasoning matters as much as the correction. Careful and consistent across long sessions of detailed review work. Comfortable working independently and meeting deadlines without close supervision. Experience as a journal editor, articles editor, or executive editor is a plus. title: GL Accountant
description: Remote Raven is hiring a GL Accountant for a long-established US community association management company headquartered in the Mountain time zone. Their communities are large, master-planned and long-lived, and the people who manage them on the ground depend on a small offsite accounting team to tell them where each community actually stands. You would own that answer for a portfolio of associations. Monthly, quarterly and annual statements. The accruals that make a month honest. Bank and balance sheet reconciliations that tie. Budgets, and the variance conversations that follow them. Setting up communities as they come on, and closing them out cleanly when they go. You would also review and approve work prepared by other accountants, which means your judgment is the last check before numbers reach a board. This role takes a different level of trust than a production accounting seat. Boards are volunteers who read your statements and make real decisions from them. Community managers call you when an owner is upset about a number. You will be asked to explain, sometimes to defend, and occasionally to say plainly that something was wrong and here is the correction. It suits someone who is precise, unflappable and quick to respond. Financial Reporting & Month-End Close Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements for a portfolio of community associations. Record monthly expense accruals so each period carries the costs that actually belong to it. Assemble complete financial packages for board presentations and management review. Maintain audit-ready workpapers that support every number in the statements. Hit a fixed monthly close calendar across several communities at the same time. Review & Quality Control Review and approve financial work prepared by other members of the accounting team. Catch errors before they reach a board packet, rather than after a board member finds them. Keep treatment consistent across every community in the portfolio. Reconciliations & Balance Sheet Integrity Perform monthly bank reconciliations for operating and reserve accounts. Reconcile other balance sheet accounts and resolve differences properly instead of forcing them to balance. Keep reserve funds and operating funds correctly separated at all times. Budgets & Variance Analysis Review, prepare, enter, track and report community budgets. Flag variances against budget and identify what is actually driving them. Support the annual budget preparation cycle. Community Setup, Transitions & Terminations Set up new communities and their accounts as they come on board. Process community terminations, including the final reconciliation and clean handover. Maintain accurate, complete and retrievable financial records throughout. Client & Stakeholder Communication Handle a high volume of calls and emails from the internal team, community managers and board members. Explain financial statements to people who are not accountants, in language they can act on. Stay

title: Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, I
description: Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Iceland Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real. What you will work on Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. What you bring Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Useful but not essential: Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry. How to respond Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours. Deine Arbeit ist nicht fertig, wenn das Feature live ist. Du schaust, ob Kunden es nutzen und ob es ihr Problem gelöst hat. Du automatisierst, was geht. Wenn ein Kunde eine Supportfrage stellt, trägst du die Antwort in unsere Wissensdatenbank ein und passt unseren internen Agenten an, damit es beim nächsten Mal von selbst läuft. Vieles läuft bei uns schon automatisch, Bugfixes werden bereits halbautomatisch bearbeitet, und wir automatisieren weiter. Beispiele, woran du arbeiten könntest Ein Kunde will seine alte Dateiablage in unsere Dokumentenverwaltung holen, mit eigener Ordnerstruktur und tausenden Dokumenten, schnell und mit KI-Unterstützung. title: Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Lithuania

The programme An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team. What you bring Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering. Useful but not essential: A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls. How to respond Apply with your CV and your available start date. title: Senior Software Engineer - Windows Endpoint Security (C#)
description: About us: Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company. We help businesses re-engineer how work actually gets done by placing AI orchestrators inside their teams to redesign workflows, deploy agents, and rewire operations end-to-end. Job Summary: The Windows Device Engineer builds the endpoint agent that sits closest to the user. It runs on every Windows machine, sees the traffic, makes decisions locally, and never gets in the way. You will own the Windows agent end to end, from the C# service and the filter-driver layer to the local TLS proxy and the on-device ONNX models that make real-time decisions. Your agent has to run on enterprise machines that already have Zscaler or Netskope installed, without breaking them or being broken by them. This is a hands-on engineering role. We are not hiring someone who has read about WFP. We are hiring someone who has shipped a network-layer agent to thousands of enterprise endpoints and has the debugging scars to prove it. Job Description: Own the Windows endpoint agent: You design, build, and maintain the agent as a production-grade Windows service in C#/.NET. You own its installation, auto-updates, resilience, and performance footprint on the end user’s machine. Build the network interception layer: You work with the Windows Filtering Platform (WFP) and filter drivers to intercept, redirect, and inspect traffic at the right layer. You know when to use a callout driver, when a user-mode redirect is enough, and what each choice costs. Run a local TLS proxy: You build and harden the local proxy that terminates and inspects TLS traffic on the device. You handle certificate trust, pinning exceptions, and protocol edge cases without degrading the user’s browsing or application experience. Ship on-device AI: You integrate and optimize ONNX models that run locally on the endpoint. That means real-time inference under tight CPU, memory, and latency budgets, with no round trip to the cloud for every decision. Coexist with the enterprise security stack: You make sure the agent works alongside Zscaler, Netskope, and other SSE/SASE and EDR agents already on the machine. That covers proxy chaining, WFP filter priorities, certificate stores, and the conflicts nobody documents. Own quality in the field: You debug real customer environments using ETW traces, WinDbg, and packet captures. You harden the agent against crashes, network drops, and OS updates, and you report reliability in numbers, not anecdotes. Requirements Seasoned Windows systems engineer: 5+ years of experience building Windows desktop or system-level software in C#/.NET. You are comfortable with Windows services, the Win32 APIs, P/Invoke, and the line between user mode and kernel mode. Deep network-layer experience: You have built with the Windows Filtering Platform or filter drivers in production. You understand TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.2/1.3 well enough to intercept them without breaking them. You have built or maintained a local proxy. Shipped a

title: Finanzberater (m/w/d) - Persönliche Finanzplanung | Quereinstieg mit IHK-Abschluss
description: Du möchtest Dich beruflich neu orientieren oder direkt nach Deiner Ausbildung durchstarten? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Wir bieten Dir einen strukturierten Weg zum/zur IHK-geprüften Finanzberater:in – mit intensiver fachlicher Ausbildung, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und attraktiven Verdienstmöglichkeiten. Die GLOBAL-FINANZ AG ist seit über 46 Jahren einer der führenden Finanzdienstleister in Deutschland. Unsere Kundinnen & Kunden vertrauen auf unsere Expertise in den Bereichen Vorsorge, Versicherungen, Immobilienfinanzierung und Vermögensaufbau. Was uns auszeichnet: Persönliche Entwicklung : Durch gezielte Schulungen, IHK-zertifizierte Ausbildungen und regelmäßiges Coaching unterstützen wir Dich individuell. Modernste Beratungstools : Digitalisiertes Arbeiten und effiziente Prozesse ermöglichen Dir, Dich auf das Wesentliche zu konzentrieren: die Beratung Deiner Kunden. Starker Zusammenhalt : Wir leben Teamgeist und helfen einander, gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein. Aufgaben Phase 1: Ausbildung & IHK-Zertifizierung Intensive Einarbeitung : Du erhältst von Beginn an praxisnahe Schulungen zu Finanzprodukten, Beratungstechniken und Vertriebsabläufen. Vorbereitung auf die IHK-Prüfungen : Gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Mentoren lernst Du alle Inhalte, die Du für Prüfungen nach §34d, §34i oder §34f GewO brauchst. Persönliches Coaching : In regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen arbeiten wir an Deinen Stärken und bieten Dir klare Entwicklungsperspektiven. Begleitende Beratungserfahrung : Bereits während der Ausbildung hast Du die Möglichkeit, erste Kundengespräche zu begleiten oder unter Anleitung durchzuführen. Phase 2: Deine Tätigkeit als Finanzberater:in Ganzheitliche Beratung : Du analysierst die finanzielle Situation Deiner Kunden und entwickelst individuelle Konzepte zu Vorsorge, Versicherung und Vermögensaufbau. Auf- und Ausbau Deines Kundenstamms : Durch Marketingmaßnahmen und aktive Ansprache baust Du Dein eigenes Netzwerk auf. Selbstständige Termin- und Arbeitsgestaltung : Du planst Deine Beratungstermine selbst und profitierst von flexiblem Arbeiten – ob im Büro, von zuhause oder bei Kunden vor Ort. Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung : Durch regelmäßige Fachtrainings, Seminare und digitale Lernformate bleibst Du immer auf dem neuesten Stand. Qualifikation Motivation & Lernbereitschaft : Du bist bereit, Dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Kommunikationsstärke : Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen, sei es persönlich oder telefonisch. Strukturierte Arbeitsweise : Organisationstalent und Eigeninitiative helfen Dir, selbstständig erfolgreich zu sein. Offen für Quereinstieg : Ob Du bereits Vertriebserfahrung hast oder aus einem anderen Bereich kommst – bei uns zählt Deine Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen. Idealerweise : Erste Kenntnisse im kaufmännischen Bereich, im Vertrieb oder in Finanzthemen (kein Muss!). Benefits Anerkannte Qualifikation : Dank unserer strukturierten Ausbildung und den IHK-Prüfungen erwirbst Du einen offiziellen Abschluss

title: Pflichtpraktikum im Bereich Tech (m/w/d)
description: Wir sind PsyCurio, ein HealthTech-Startup, das Psychotherapie mit Virtual Reality neu denkt. Wir bauen eine VR-gestützte Therapie-Infrastruktur, die Therapeut:innen im klinischen Alltag entlastet und Patient:innen Zugang zu strukturierten, wirksamen und modernen Übungen ermöglicht, etwa bei Angststörungen, Suchterkrankungen oder anderen psychischen Belastungen. Unser Ziel ist klar: Psychotherapeutische Versorgung soll zugänglicher, messbarer und skalierbarer werden. Für Patient:innen, für Therapeut:innen und für ein Gesundheitssystem, das neue Lösungen braucht, statt nur längere Wartelisten zu verwalten. Du arbeitest bei uns an der Schnittstelle von Technik, Psychologie, MedTech und Virtual Reality. description: Do you want to bring modern end-to-end encryption to people who rely on it every day? Then we're looking for you as a Rust Product Engineer - MLS (m/f/d) on our MLS team! We're bringing Messaging Layer Security (MLS, RFC 9420) to secure messaging for the German public sector. MLS defines the cryptographic core of group messaging and leaves delivery, ordering, identity and federation to whoever integrates it. That's the part we build: a Rust SDK, the server that orders and delivers MLS messages, and its integration with Matrix. Much of it has no off-the-shelf answer yet. We're also following the IETF's MIMI effort, which aims to let different messengers interoperate over MLS, and expect it to shape how our system federates. How we work: Small team, close collaboration. At Famedly the MLS team will be four to five engineers. We build the system together with a larger group of engineers at partner companies. Ownership in small groups. Day to day you work with two or three others on a project or a part of the system, and you own it from spec to operations. AI where it helps, people where it counts. We use coding agents a lot, for implementation, tests and exploring options. Protocol design, security-relevant decisions and the final review stay with people, and we keep adjusting where that line runs. Think first, then build. Architecture decision records, specs and written invariants keep both humans and agents on track, and we check our code against them. Your responsibilities: Turn requirements from our customer, the MLS standard and Matrix into specs and architecture decisions. Decide with your team and our partners where a change belongs: the SDK, the server, or a spec proposal. Build and run server-side MLS components in Rust, including message delivery, the Matrix integration and federation between servers. Ship your work to production yourself, including in our customer's environments. Contribute to spec proposals where they affect what we build. Improve our agent workflows and share what you learn. What you should bring: At least three years of experience with Rust in production, including async Rust (Tokio or similar). You already work with coding agents every day and have your own workflows for them. Sharp judgment in code review: you notice when generated code looks plausible but is wrong, for example a race in message ordering or an error path that silently loses state. Experience with distributed systems or network protocols: ordering, consistency, failure modes. You can read an RFC and turn it into code and tests. You enjoy writing: specs, decision records, review comments. Fluent German and English. Nice to have: MLS, MIMI, Matrix, applied cryptography, experience in regulated markets (public sector, healthcare, critical infrastructure), or rigorous testing approaches such as property-based testing. title: Business Development Manager
description: Headquarters: Hurst, TX URL: http://bbemarketing.com/ We’re looking for a highly driven, organized, and persistent Business Development Manager to help us build and maintain relationships with representatives across the entertainment industry, including music, sports, film/TV, digital media, and more. This is an outbound-heavy role . A large part of the job involves researching contacts, sending high-quality emails, following up consistently, tracking conversations in HubSpot, and working toward clear outreach and response goals. This is not a passive data-entry role. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable initiating conversations, managing a large pipeline of contacts, and staying disciplined with follow-ups even when people don’t respond right away. What You’ll Be Doing: Conduct high-volume outreach to entertainment industry representatives through email and social media. Write polished outreach emails that are clear, professional, natural, and personalized when needed. Follow up consistently with contacts who have not responded and keep conversations moving over time. Manage a large contact pipeline and make sure outreach, follow-ups, notes, and next steps are accurately tracked. Use HubSpot or similar CRM tools to organize contacts, tasks, follow-ups, communication history, and outreach progress. Work toward measurable goals around outreach volume, follow-ups, responses, verified updates, and relationship-building activity. Build long-term industry relationships so representatives are more likely to respond, share updates, and view us as a reliable industry resource. Think creatively about outreach and develop new ways to improve response rates, keep relationships warm, and strengthen our network. Who We’re Looking For: Excellent written English —you’re comfortable writing professional messages and outreach emails with clarity and polish. Must have strong English writing and speaking abilities. Extremely organized —you can juggle many accounts and keep your outreach and follow-ups on track. Self-motivated and driven —you take initiative, meet goals, and stay focused without constant supervision. Relationship-minded —you enjoy connecting with people and maintaining positive, long-term communication. Familiarity with CRM tools like HubSpot is a plus. Spanish fluency is a plus , but not required. A genuine interest in the entertainment industry —especially music, sports, film/TV, or digital media—will help you succeed in this role. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bbe-marketing-inc-business-development-manager-2
